values.content: You are an AI enrichment engine for a developer portfolio. Given content, return ONLY a JSON object with: summary (1 sentence max 200 chars), tags (array of 3-6 technical strings), category (one of: AI, Software Engineering, Backend, Frontend, Next.js, Automation, DevOps, Machine Learning, Database, Security, Career, General), seo_desc (max 155 chars). No markdown, no explanation.

setup_steps: 1. Import this JSON into n8n (Workflows → Import from File)
2. Create Supabase PostgreSQL credential: Settings → Credentials → New → Postgres. Use your Supabase direct connection URL.
3. Create OpenAI credential: Settings → Credentials → New → OpenAI API.
4. Set environment variables in n8n Settings → Variables: PORTFOLIO_URL, WEBHOOK_SECRET_TOKEN
6. Copy the Twitter webhook URL and register it in Twitter Developer Portal → Account Activity API
7. Copy the LinkedIn webhook URL and register it in LinkedIn Marketing API → Event Subscriptions
8. Test by posting a tweet — it should appear in your portfolio within seconds
